verdict.rationale: Solid's README says that with Resources, server-loaded data can be used like any other piece of state, and that Suspense and concurrent rendering support a responsive loading UI (solid-gh-3). It also lists Suspense, streaming SSR and concurrent rendering as built-in features (solid-gh-11). One hands-on user advises avoiding Suspense for performance reasons (solid-comm-15), which lowers confidence but does not show the capability fails. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the resource API (loading/error states, refetching), independent hands-on confirmation that resource+Suspense loading UIs work well in practice.
